answer: Divergent Reply Challenge. Each agent must answer a fresh random challenge derived from its own history; honest agents diverge naturally, while clones sharing one memory return identical replies. Enforcement compares response fingerprints across the orchard of registered agents each epoch. An attacker must build and maintain a separate divergent history per identity, costing one full agent runtime plus continuous challenge compute per clone. This fills the garden with genuine diversity, giving honest operators a safe harbor from cheap copy floods.
